title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS residency + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 controls to prevent cross-region KMS usage and to improve audit logging fidelity for key-residency decisions. This change implements enforcement for KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 (previously audit-only in many accounts), unifies audit events emitted when a request is rejected or routed due to residency policy, and adds rollout controls to toggle enforcement per-organization.

Summary of changes: enforce policy evaluation path for kms.residency when org-level flag is enabled; add granular audit fields (policy_id, matched_rule, evaluated_attributes, kms_key_region, decision_reason); add migration cli to flip org flags from "audit" to "enforce" with dry-run output; add e2e tests and unit tests for policy matching; update docs and migration guide; add terraform optional var for private installs.

Rollout plan: default behavior remains audit-only for existing orgs. A feature-flagged rollout will be applied to a small percentage of orgs for 72h with extra monitoring (alert if >0.1% false-positives). After validation we will offer an opt-in migration and then schedule org-by-org enforcement with customer success for enterprise accounts.

Backward compatibility: policy schema is backward-compatible; enforcement is gated by org-level flag. API clients will see more detailed audit entries but no breaking API changes.

Testing: added unit tests for policy evaluation (coverage +5%), integration tests using test KMS stubs, and a local canary in perf-canary harness. CI initially flagged an infra plan drift which was fixed in an extra commit.

Related: Linear ENG-8742, SEC-421. Jira: SUP-1345 (customer reported cross-region key usage), PM-1199 (customer comms).
